text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While facing off against Rulership in a new board game
at her stronghold—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, is Ruler around?
I need to talk with her for a bit."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Ugh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I just heard an "Ack!" from in there.
You're home, right? Pretending you're not won't work on me.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hold on.
Isn't it common courtesy to get the owner's permission before entering a room?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...You're a chronic slacker. You're the last person
I want a lecture on manners from.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
......Mejiro Dober.
I'm sorry for causing such a fuss.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober.
Sorry to drop in on you out of nowhere.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't that way different from how you treat me...?
...Whatever. So, what do you need?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"What's it about," you ask...?
You ditched the match race that Air Groove-senpai
set up for you again, didn't you!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that matter? I properly contacted
Air Groove-san to cancel, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You only contacted me the night before!
Even though you went through all the trouble of preparing for it, Senior.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: "So that's why you went out of your way to come nag me on behalf of your beloved senpai, huh... How admirable."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Even Air Groove-san gave her approval this time, you know? Though she did tell me there won't be a next time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Stop taking advantage of Senpai's generosity...!
If you keep causing trouble, I won't forgive you."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how terrifying.
You say you won't forgive me, little miss, but do you have a plan?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I've only been bringing you these handouts because our desks are next to each other, but I'm going to stop now. Besides—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Whenever you skip homeroom at the end of the day
or rush off early, I'm gonna tattle to Air Groove-senpai every single time.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Haaah!? Whoa, that card is totally banned!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...There'd be no need for that
if you just led a proper life, you know?
choice_data_list: (It doesn't seem like they're on bad terms, but...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I watched the two interact,
thinking what a truly curious relationship they had.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Haa, hah....
Kh...! Not yet――

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yo, putting in some dead-serious running today, huh?
Still, aren't you running yourself a bit too ragged?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, ...I don't have time to act calm.
Just leave me alone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Because next time, I absolutely cannot afford to lose.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ah, come to think of it, you have a mock race coming up.
You want to avenge your previous loss, is that it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...After Air Groove-senpai went out of her way
to coach me, how could I put on such a pathetic display?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If you understand, then stay out of my way.
Right now, every single second counts.
In order to... win at all costs...!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"...All the more reason to stop.
If you narrow your vision, you'll never see the path to victory."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Racing isn't just about charging straight ahead.
If you want to win, you've got to have tricky tactics in your hand, too.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—I can deal you the best hand possible.
Well? ...Are you in?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ruler...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
――I'm in.
If it's to win... I'll do whatever it takes!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ("Take a bird's-eye view. Look at the whole battle, not just what's in front of you. Even view yourself as just another piece on the board—")

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! An unexpected surge here from Mejiro Dober!
So fast, so fast! She's closing the gap in an instant!

text_block_list.name: Commentating Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
She pushed too far forward early on and seemed to run
too eagerly, but... was that impatience all an act?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Haaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Ruler.
I won the practice race.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I was watching. The strategy I gave you worked like a charm, didn't it? Just like I said.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...
Um, th-thank—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Then in exchange, can I assume you'll turn a blind eye to any minor issues down the road?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: No. That's one thing, this is another!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Just when I was starting to think better of you... Can't you do something about that lack of seriousness?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
No, no, if I turned into some straight-laced goody two-shoes, I'd totally lose my identity.
Right, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Still, it might be better to be a little more proper.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
No, no, if I turned into some straight-laced goody two-shoes, I'd totally lose my identity.
Right, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Still, it might be better to be a little more proper.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Knowing the importance of tactics and with plenty of match experience,
there's a path to victory only she can see.
choice_data_list: And I've seen situations like that plenty of times before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, I want her to pull herself together
so she doesn't trouble Air Groove-senpai or anyone else...!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Haha— If you want me to obey, you can just beat me at chess. How about it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "Geez! You know I'm bad at chess!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
What's that...!
Trainer, are you on the opposing team's side?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Good.
It seems my Trainer has some common sense after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Um... please take care of Ruler.
Make sure she doesn't cause trouble for anyone...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to continuing to work with you.
As fellow supporters of the Ruler,
let's keep a sharp eye out together.
